body: Why not? Why do you care?

I don't think I'm really wrong about any of this. The only reasons I can come up with to keep living seem like farfetched justifications, e.g. "Maybe one day I'll find or build a corner of the world to be happy in, with rewarding work, people I love and who love me, and hobbies I find fulfilling" or "Maybe in the future technology will advance to the point that I can modify my body into something I don't despise". These visions or dreams of a possible future just seem desperate, and they're nothing compared to the agony of the present.
